name: ruflo-ruvllm
description: RuVLLM local inference with chat formatting (Claude/GPT/Gemini/Ollama/Cohere), model configuration, MicroLoRA fine-tuning, SONA real-time adaptation, and a guide to the @ruvector/ruvllm 4.1 runtime vs the GPU-loop harness. As a mod (ADR-445): a guard that keeps secrets out of adapters and the pattern router, /ruvllm-mod, and a status file the console shows

guard.title: Secret guard
guard.description: Refuse calls to this plugin's write tools that hold a key, token or password.
